blocks.body: Processing is a beginner-friendly programming language that lets you use code to sketch. From simple drawings and animations to complex interactive installations and performances, these creative tools make it easy to bring your ideas to life.

items.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship
items.description: Since 2013, the Processing Foundation Fellowship has supported emerging artists, educators, and coders in imagining more just and equitable relationships with technology.

items.title: Processing Foundation Grants
items.description: Processing Foundation offers grants and mentorship opportunities that support the people who build Processing. These grants offer paid pathways into open-source contribution by compensating time, knowledge, and experience while helping developers expand their skills through hands-on projects.

items.title: Processing Foundation Community Day
items.description: Started in 2017, Processing Community Day (PCD) is a global network of community-led events that bring together the open-source community to celebrate art, code, and creative tools.

intro.title: Working with the community
intro.description: Processing Foundation provides funding, infrastructure, and toolkits to support Processing communities across the U.S. and globally.
